- Against the card and the eval it serves: an agent authoring a report from this file now sees the download declared beside the period, with the permission named in words on the object — exactly what the eval scores and what the schema's guidance string says. Against the standing ruling 「10402 需要整体考虑 skills 的长度,不能为了一个小功能扩写很多」: +4 lines of teaching paid by −6 lines of restatement; the file shrinks. Against the four-axis frame: focus (one example line, one sentence, no new section), AI-error (the permission is not written as a report key — the trap the eval guards against is named, not tolerated), long-run (the keys are the schema's, read off `report.zod.ts`, not paraphrased).
